WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
timespan_means AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(avg_fill) as mean_fill
  FROM order_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
),
filtered_and_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    of.ordersmark,
    of.timespan,
    of.avg_fill,
    (of.avg_fill - tm.mean_fill) as exceeds,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY of.timespan ORDER BY of.avg_fill DESC) as rnk
  FROM order_fills of
  JOIN timespan_means tm ON of.timespan = tm.timespan
  WHERE of.avg_fill > tm.mean_fill
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  exceeds,
  rnk
FROM filtered_and_ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rnk
